arxiv-2011-05380.title: Entanglement, Renormalization and Effective Field Theories
arxiv-2011-05380.creator: Bingzheng Han, and Ratindranath Akhoury
arxiv-2011-05380.description: Abstract We develop the idea that renormalization, decoupling of heavy particle effects from low energy physics and the construction of effective field theories are intimately linked to the momentum space entanglement of disparate modes of an interacting quantum field theory.

arxiv-2104-13973.title: The polarizability of a confined atomic system: An application of Dalgarno-Lewis method
arxiv-2104-13973.creator: T. V. C. Antão, N. M. R. Peres
arxiv-2104-13973.description: Abstract In this paper we give an application of Dalgarno-Lewis method, the latter not usually taught in quantum mechanics courses. This is very unfortunate since this method allows to bypass the sum over states appearing in the usual perturbation theory.

arxiv-2212-03574.title: Learning rigid dynamics with face interaction graph networks
arxiv-2212-03574.creator: Kelsey R. Allen, Yulia Rubanova, Tatiana Lopez-Guevara, William Whitney Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez , Peter Battaglia , Tobias Pfaff DeepMind, London, UK
arxiv-2212-03574.description: Abstract Simulating rigid collisions among arbitrary shapes is notoriously difficult due to complex geometry and the strong non-linearity of the interactions. While graph neural network (GNN)-based models are effective at learning to simulate complex physical dynamics, such as fluids, cloth and articulated bodies, they have been less effective and efficient on rigid-body physics, except with very simple shapes.

arxiv-2306-07572.title: Clairaut anti-invariant Riemannian maps to trans-Sasakian manifolds
arxiv-2306-07572.creator: Adeeba Zaidi, Gauree Shanker
arxiv-2306-07572.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Adeeba Zaidi, Gauree Shanker. In this article, we introduce Clairaut anti-invariant Riemannian maps from Riemannian manifolds to trans-Sasakian manifolds. We derive necessary and sufficient condition for an anti-invariant map to be Clairaut when base manifold is trans-Sasakian manifold. We discuss the integrability of r ​ a ​ n ​ g ​ e ​ π ∗ range\pi_{*} and ( r ​ a ​ n ​ g ​ e ​ π ∗ ) ⟂ (range\pi_{*})^{\perp} . Further, we establish harmonicity of these map.

arxiv-2508-06481.title: High precision measurement of phi-nucleon cross section using a tensor polarized deuteron target (PAC53)
arxiv-2508-06481.creator: Mark M. Dalton †, Alexandre Deur ∗, Chris D. Keith ∗, Nadia Fomin ∗, Theory support: Misak Sargsian
arxiv-2508-06481.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mark M. Dalton †, Alexandre Deur ∗, Chris D. Keith ∗, Nadia Fomin ∗, Theory support: Misak Sargsian. Executive Summary

We propose to measure the
\phi
-nucleon cross section
\sigma_{\phi N}
to solve the longstanding
puzzle of whether
\sigma_{\phi N}\simeq 10
mb, as extracted from photoproduction, or
\sim
30 mb, as obtained from nuclear rescattering. CLAS data demonstrated that even precision data for unpolarized
\phi
photoproduction are insufficient to unambiguously extract
\sigma_{\phi N}
, allowing the possibilities of both
\sigma_{\phi N}
values.

pmc-11350173.title: Finite control set model predictive current control for three phase grid connected inverter with common mode voltage suppression
pmc-11350173.creator: Ali Bebboukha, Redha Meneceur, Labiod Chouaib, Mohammad Anas Anees, Ahmed Elsanabary, Saad Mekhilef, Abualkasim Bakeer, Ibrahim Harbi, Ievgen Zaitsev, Mohit Bajaj
pmc-11350173.description: This research introduces an advanced finite control set model predictive current control (FCS-MPCC) specifically tailored for three-phase grid-connected inverters, with a primary focus on the suppression of common mode voltage (CMV). CMV is known for causing a range of issues, including leakage currents, electromagnetic interference (EMI), and accelerated system degradation.

pmc-11523230.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Solvated Lanthanide(II) Bis(triisopropylsilyl)phosphide Complexes
pmc-11523230.creator: Jack Baldwin, Adam Brookfield, George F. S. Whitehead, Louise S. Natrajan, Eric J. L. McInnes, Meagan S. Oakley, David P. Mills
pmc-11523230.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Lanthanide (Ln) silylamide chemistry is well-developed, but the corresponding silylphosphide chemistry is immature; there are only ten structurally characterized examples of Ln(II) bis(trimethylsilyl)phosphide complexes to date and no reported derivatives with bulkier R-groups. Here, we report the synthesis of the first f-block bis(triisopropylsilyl)phosphide complexes, [Ln{P(SiiPr3)2}2(THF)x] (1-Ln; Ln = Sm, Eu, x = 3; Ln = Yb, x = 2), by the respective salt metathesis reactions of parent [LnI2(THF)2] with 2 equiv of [Na{P(SiiPr3)2}]n in toluene.

pmc-11895706.title: Negotiating extirpation: On the political implications of declaring dugongs extinct in Okinawan waters
pmc-11895706.creator: Marius Palz, Alison Dunn, Barry Brook, Alison Dunn, Barry Brook, Alison Dunn, Barry Brook
pmc-11895706.description: In 2021, scientists published a preprint stating that the dugong population of Okinawa had declined below the minimum viable population and should be considered extinct. The publication led to an outcry amongst Japanese/Okinawan environmentalists and to criticism by international dugong specialists.

pmc-11912858.title: THE PREVALENCE OF ORTHOREXIA NERVOSA AMONG GYM PARTICIPANTS FROM CROATIA: AN OBSERVATIONAL STUDY
pmc-11912858.creator: Edita Ružman, Orjena Žaja, Jadranka Karuza, Ines Banjari
pmc-11912858.description: SUMMARYOrthorexia nervosa (ON) is pathological obsession and preoccupation with ‘healthy’ and ‘clean’ eating, which is more pronounced in specific population groups such as fitness enthusiasts. The aim of this observational study was to determine the prevalence and characteristics of ON symptoms among gym attendees in Croatia based on ORTHO-15 questionnaire.

pmc-12516390.title: Identification and Exploration of a Series of SARS-Cov‑2 MPro Cyano-Based Inhibitors Revealing Ortho-Substitution Effects within the P3 Biphenyl Group
pmc-12516390.creator: Emma Clyde-Allen, Mikołaj Zmudzinski, Mohammad Afsar, Ciyana James, Anindita Nayak, Digant Nayak, Priscila dos Santos Bury, Dirk Jochmans, Johann Neyts, Christopher J. Scott, Shaun K. Olsen, Marcin Drag, Rich Williams
pmc-12516390.description: Starting from a simple scaffold hopping exercise based on our previous exploration of cysteine protease inhibitors against legumain, compound 6a was identified as a starting point for the development of a SARS-CoV-2 main protease (MPro) inhibitor. Compound 6a displayed submicromolar biochemical potency in the ultrasensitive assay developed by Drag and co-workers.

pmc-12555827.title: Migration and fetal health anxiety with related variables in Türkiye: A cross-sectional study
pmc-12555827.creator: F Akbay, T Arslan Torba, O Er, M F Önsüz, S Metintaş, M Velipaşaoğlu, M C Keven, B Derim Yeğen, E Aydoğdu
pmc-12555827.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMigration status can influence pregnancy through sociocultural and healthcare dynamics. Fetal health anxiety refers to concerns about the fetus's well-being. This study aimed to compare fetal health anxiety and sociodemographic and obstetric factors between migrant and non-migrant pregnant individuals.MethodsThis cross-sectional study was conducted between December 2024 and February 2025 at two hospitals in Eskişehir, Türkiye, among pregnant individuals attending antenatal care.

pmc-12635873.title: Nirsevimab Prophylaxis and Respiratory Syncytial Virus Hospitalizations Among Infants
pmc-12635873.creator: Enrico Cocchi, Silvia Bloise, Aurora Lorefice, Sara Zannoni, Benedetta Pellegrini, Francesco Saverio Morlupo, Beatrice Scarpellini, Melodie O. Aricò, Francesco Accomando, Gina Ancora, Gianluca Vergine, Enrico Valletta, Marcello Stella, Federico Marchetti
pmc-12635873.description: This cohort study examines whether nirsevimab prophylaxis administered to newborns is associated with risk of hospitalization for and clinical severity of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in the first year of life. Introduction Lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) are the leading cause of hospital admission in infants, contributing to a significant seasonal health care burden.

pmc-12696342.title: Protein O‐GlcNAcylation in Health and Diseases
pmc-12696342.creator: Zhihong Ran, Chuanbao Chen, Jingfeng Ou, Guanyi Wu, Chao Yang, Xiaoyou Liu
pmc-12696342.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). O‐GlcNAcylation is a reversible posttranslational modification of proteins that has garnered significant attention in recent years. By regulating the structure and function of proteins, it plays a critical role in various biological processes. Normal O‐GlcNAcylation is essential for maintaining internal homeostasis and is involved in controlling fundamental biological events such as gene expression, the cell cycle regulation, metabolism, and signal transduction.

pmc-13087233.title: Research on hydraulic shock suppression of crawler crane slewing mechanism based on hydraulic simulation
pmc-13087233.creator: Yulan Wei, Yuncong Gu, Yang Zhang, Tongxi Zhu, Boyang Zhang, Qingzhu Zhang, Qiang Zhang, Bing Li
pmc-13087233.description: During the rapid startup and braking of the crawler crane’s slewing mechanism, excessive transient pressure peaks in the hydraulic motor’s inlet and return lines generate significant hydraulic shock. This shock induces intense vibration in the cab, compromising operational safety and reducing the equipment’s service life. First, baseline hydraulic data were analyzed to identify the underlying causes of the hydraulic shock.

pmc-13090963.title: Circulating low-density neutrophils as biomarkers of resistance to first-line anti-PD-1/PD-L1 immunotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13090963.creator: N Castro, I Labiano, M Martínez-Aguillo, AE Huerta, I Morilla, L Teijeira, D Serrano, I Caseda, A Lecumberri, I Amat, M Zuazo, L Chocarro, E Blanco, D Escors, G Kochan, J Fernández Irigoyen, R Vera, A Calvo, M Alsina, H Arasanz
pmc-13090963.description: Highlights•High levels of circulating LDNs predict resistant to ICI monotherapy in aNSCLC.•Chemotherapy plus ICI overcome LDN-associated resistance due to LDN depletion.•LDNs display aging phenotype and a unique proteome versus conventional neutrophils.•LDN depletion enhances ICI efficacy in an in vivo Lewis Lung Carcinoma model.

pmc-13215557.title: Lunar base agent-based modeling - A benchmark for simulating crewed space missions
pmc-13215557.creator: Raymond Vera, Anamaria Berea, William G Kennedy, Babak Aslani, Birendra Mishra, Babak Aslani, Babak Aslani
pmc-13215557.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Space exploration has progressed significantly since the mid-20th century, and recent technological advancements, along with the emergence of commercial space travel, have led to substantial leaps in planning for future space missions. The largest planned upcoming mission is the Artemis program, supported by NASA and the international Artemis Accords, which aims to create the first permanent human presence on the Moon and in deep space (the Moon to Mars architecture).

pmc-13363641.title: Systemic Hypertension and Predictors of Recanalization After Endovascular Coil Embolization of Intracranial Aneurysms: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13363641.creator: Jin Byung Park, Su Hwan Lee, Kyuhyuck Lee
pmc-13363641.description: Objective: Systemic hypertension is a well-established risk factor for the development, growth, and rupture of intracranial aneurysms. However, its association with aneurysm recanalization after endovascular coil embolization remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between systemic hypertension and recanalization after coil embolization, and to identify additional risk factors associated with recanalization.

pmc-13574157.title: Cilia–to–basement membrane signaling is a biomechanical driver in models of autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease
pmc-13574157.creator: Manal Mazloum, Brice Lapin, Rushdi Alghamdi, Jessica Vandensteen, Martine Burtin, Pascal Houillier, Lydie Cheval, Gilles Crambert, Vicky Scata, Camille Cohen, Christoph Schell, Michael Rehman, Amandine Aka, Karim Ourahmoun, Rui Benedito, E. Wolfgang Kuehn, Stéphanie Descroix, Tilman Busch, Michael K
pmc-13574157.description: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), the leading genetic cause of kidney failure, results from loss-of-function mutations in PKD1, encoding polycystin-1 (PC1). PC1 localizes to the primary cilium. In the absence of PC1, adverse signaling from the primary cilium orchestrates cyst formation, but the biomechanical underpinnings of this cilia-dependent cyst activation (CDCA) remain unclear.

pmc-13594894.title: A mugwort-based Chinese herbal mixture of five herbs improved oviduct health in laying hens under LPS challenge
pmc-13594894.creator: Xuan Cui, Jiandan Luo, Xuemei Ding, Qiufeng Zeng, Shiping Bai, Xiangbing Mao, Gang Jia, Yan Liu, Jianping Wang
pmc-13594894.description: This study aimed to investigate the preventive effects of Chinese herbal mixture on salpingitis and its impacts on production performance and egg quality in laying hens challenged with lipopolysaccharide (LPS). The experiment consisted of two phases. In the feeding phase, 160 Lohmann pink-shell laying hens (45 weeks old) were randomly assigned to two treatments.
